$comment: EDITABLE crop overrides. Overrides always win over auto-detection. After a pipeline run, copy values from build/reports/resolved-crops.json into this file to freeze them. See docs/SPEC-01-ASSET-PIPELINE.md section 1.5.

PROTAGONIST_SOURCE.$selection_note: Leave empty to use the leg-split heuristic from SPEC-01 s1.8. Once reviewed, paste the exact 10 region ids here in final frame order (idleA, idleB, run x4, opposite-foot, airborne-recovery, jump, fall).
PROTAGONIST_SOURCE.$chroma_note: Lossy WebP drifted the mint field; measured border deviation reached 44. tol=50 with merge_gap=0 is the only setting that separates all 12 poses.

ICONS_SOURCE.$skip_note: Record here the region ids of the redundant landscape variants and the extra magenta mechanical object so the report lists them as SKIPPED rather than missing.

ENEMIES_ITEMS_SOURCE.$screen_interior_note: Per-enemy rects of the baked screen text (e.g. JOB FAIL), stored so a later update can replace them with pixel symbols without redoing crops. MVP keeps the baked text.

EFFECTS_SOURCE.$chroma_policy_note: REQUIRED. The seven aura rings are hollow: the mint inside each ring touches no board edge, so the default edge-connected policy leaves it opaque and the 'aura centre must be empty' validation fails. Proven by tools/selftest_pipeline.py. Safe here because no effects artwork uses the chroma key.

HUD_BLOCKS_SOURCE.$clean_regions_note: Each entry: { id, panel, rect: [x,y,w,h], sample_at: [x,y] }. rect is in SOURCE board pixels. sample_at picks the dark fill colour from inside the same panel - the fill is sampled, never invented.
HUD_BLOCKS_SOURCE.$note: Detects 11 regions: 9 gameplay tiles plus 2 full-width HUD bands. The four HUD panels are connected through their own backdrop and cannot be split by connectivity, so they need explicit rects in `panels`.

BACKGROUNDS_SOURCE.$seam_mode_note: repeat = tile the strip as-is. mirror = mirror alternate tiles, which guarantees a seamless join at the cost of symmetry.
